notes: A kart racer run over laps against a field is Circuit Racing on route-circuit, and the answers pin it down: three laps, up to eight racers, so a wide starting grid and lap detection at the line, with a terminal finish trigger for the third crossing. Fall-away edges and a recovery point are included because one of the three tracks is in the clouds and a racer knocked off it has to be restored to the course; guardrails and hairpins cover the mall and forest tracks. P6 is genre-wide and stays, and P4 is earned because three distinctly themed tracks cannot share one surface — but no P3, since the author's answer makes the mall track fully indoors, which is one interior with no outside-to-inside transition to link. Two requests have no row anywhere in Racing's table and are recorded here rather than dropped: the coins that give slight speed increases, and the item pickups (shell, banana, mushroom, triple mushroom, homing red shell, lightning) that need boxes distributed along the corridor; also worth flagging that P4 is not the proven route today, so building one track first is the fallback.
